findings.summary: `IsAllowed` trims the candidate but not the supplied allowlist entries; the production path is nevertheless correct because `BadgeDefinition` trims every entry at construction.
findings.detail: `BadgeSelectorResolver.IsAllowed` trims only the candidate value and compares against `allowedValues` verbatim. ADR-017 clause 2 trims the comparison value and clause 5 trims the configured entries; the resolved allowlist reaching the renderer is always `BadgeDefinition.AllowedValues`, which is built by `NormalizeAllowedValues` and trims (and copies) every entry. `RendererConfigurationResolver.ResolveDefinitions` constructs `BadgeDefinition` from the persisted entries, so the only production caller is guaranteed trimmed entries. The public `IsAllowed` method would not match untrimmed entries passed directly by an external caller, but no such caller exists. Not required for this task; noted as a minor API-contract observation.
findings.recommended_action: None required; optionally document in the `IsAllowed` XML comment that entries are expected to be pre-trimmed, or trim defensively.

findings.detail: `tests/ArrTags.Tests/Goldens/` is clean (`git status --short` empty), and the default suite reports the same 63 skips as the pre-task baseline (no new skips). The golden and cross-runtime facts are `[SkiaNativeTheory]`/`[NonCanonicalRuntimeFact]` and are skipped without `ARRTAGS_SKIA_COMPAT=1`. Forcing `ARRTAGS_SKIA_COMPAT=1` in this environment fails with a native `SkiaSharp.SKColorSpace.CreateSrgb()` failure, i.e. the pinned native runtime is not usable here, so the goldens could not be executed. The unchanged default configuration has an empty allowlist, which `IsAllowed` treats as no restriction and which the task 12.1 fingerprint work treats as identity-neutral, so the rendered output is unchanged by construction. The 'goldens pass unchanged' claim is therefore supported by source inspection and the unmodified golden set, not by an executed golden run.

acceptance_criteria_assessment.a_configured_allowlist_restricts_renderi: MET. `BadgeDefinitionResolver.Resolve` filters each resolved pre-template `value.Text` through `BadgeSelectorResolver.IsAllowed(value.Text, definition.AllowedValues)` before applying the template. Tests `AllowlistRequiresAnExactCaseInsensitiveMatch`, `CustomBadgeAllowlistAppliesPerRetainedValue`, `AudioAllowlistMatchesTheFullComposite`, `UpgradePendingAllowlistPermitsTheFixedStatusText`, and `FilterIsAppliedBeforeTheDefinitionTemplate` assert retention and suppression. Mutation of `IsAllowed` to always allow caused 6 of the 8 `BadgeAllowlistFilterTests` to fail, so the tests are non-vacuous.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.unknown_and_absent_values_remain_omitted: MET. Unknown/absent values are never emitted by `BadgeSelectorResolver.Resolve`, and `IsAllowed` only removes already-confirmed values (empty allowlist returns true; non-empty only matches present text). Test `UnknownAndAbsentValuesRemainOmittedWithAnAllowlist` asserts an empty selection when no quality/audio is confirmed even with a non-empty allowlist. The filter cannot widen an omission.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.an_empty_allowlist_means_no_restriction: MET. `IsAllowed` returns true immediately when `allowedValues.Count == 0`; `BadgeDefinition` normalizes null/empty to an empty read-only list. Tests `IsAllowedTrimsTheResolvedValueAndRejectsPartialMatches` and `EmptyAllowlistMeansNoRestriction` assert the behavior; the default `BadgeDefinition.V1Default` carries empty allowlists.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.match_semantics_exact_case_insensitive_o: MET. `string.Equals(candidate, allowed, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)` after `value.Trim()`; configured entries are trimmed by `BadgeDefinition.NormalizeAllowedValues`. No substring/prefix/wildcard/regex path exists. Tests assert no substring/prefix/wildcard match (`Bluray`, `1080p`, `Bluray-1080p-extra`, `Bluray*` all filtered) and that `  Bluray-1080p  ` matches.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.filter_before_template_order: MET. The allowlist test uses the pre-template value (`value.Text`) and the template is applied only to retained values; test `FilterIsAppliedBeforeTheDefinitionTemplate` shows an allowlist naming the templated text (`Q:Bluray-1080p`) filters the value out while an allowlist naming the pre-template value retains it and then applies the template.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.per_custom_value_and_full_audio_composit: MET. `BadgeSelectorResolver.Resolve` emits one `BadgeValue` per retained custom badge (filtered independently) and one full `Audio` composite (`Atmos/TrueHD/8`); a component alone (`TrueHD`, `Atmos`) does not match. The fixed `UpgradePending` status text is filtered and can be suppressed.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.allowlisted_but_unfittable_still_shorten: MET. The filter runs before `BadgeLayoutEngine.Build`; `AnAllowlistedValueThatCannotFitStillFollowsTheOmitBehavior` retains an allowlisted custom value and then asserts the layout omits it because it cannot fit.

summary: The functional implementation of task 12.2 is correct and complete. `BadgeSelectorResolver.IsAllowed` implements the ADR-017 match exactly: an empty allowlist is unrestricted, otherwise the resolved pre-template value is trimmed and compared by a case-insensitive ordinal exact match with no substring/prefix/wildcard/regex path; configured entries are trimmed by `BadgeDefinition`. `BadgeDefinitionResolver.Resolve` applies the filter to each resolved pre-template value (and to the fixed `UpgradePending` text) before the definition template, giving value resolution -> allowlist filter -> template -> normalization/truncation -> layout; it applies per retained `CustomBadge` value and to the full `Audio` composite, permits the fixed status text, keeps unknown/absent values omitted, never widens an omission, and does not bypass the shorten/omit layout behavior. Scope boundaries hold: no size/position work, schema and renderer versions remain 1 and 2, and no golden under tests/ArrTags.Tests/Goldens/ changed. Independent build/test reproduce the worker's counts exactly (build 0/0; suite Failed 0, Passed 1445, Skipped 63, Total 1508; focused 39/0/39), and a mutation run confirmed the new tests are non-vacuous (6/8 fail when the filter is forced to allow). The only required correction is documentation current-state: docs/project-status.md and docs/implementation-readiness.md were not reconciled with the task 12.2 phase status and test count, which the documented canonical-surface workflow requires. Review is CHANGES_REQUIRED with one MEDIUM required change; no functional or architectural blocker.
